errors.text: The proposed Al addition does not reconstruct the demonstrated 4.2 at.% Cr intervention or the Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.
No cited evidence establishes that 2–5 at.% Al in HfMoTaTiZr forms a reticulated B2 or Laves-phase network.

The falsification experiment does not distinguish solid-solution hardening from the phase-network mechanism; it lacks a matched single-phase solute control or quantitative separation of lattice contraction, phase fraction, morphology, and strength.
The density prediction is internally inconsistent: adding low-density Al would generally be expected to reduce, not slightly increase, alloy density.
